_comment: Balance values live here, not in code — MASTER_PLAN.md section 5, and CLAUDE.md.
Every number below is PLACEHOLDER. Phase 5 tunes the real curve against a
spreadsheet before it is tuned in the game. What matters now is that the loop
closes: each building pays for the next one, so there is always a reason to
place something.
cost      what it takes to place, deducted immediately
produces  resource and amount, added every `interval` seconds once built
build_s   seconds from placement to finished. Kept short on purpose while this
is a proof of concept: a wait you cannot see the end of reads as a
fault, and these were long enough that the owner reported the
under-construction state as a rendering bug. Phase 5 sets the real
curve, with a progress bar and a Finish Now button beside it.
max_level how far it can be upgraded
upgrade   what each level multiplies. Level N costs cost * upgrade.cost^(N-1),
takes build_s * upgrade.build_s^(N-1), and yields produces.amount *
upgrade.produces^(N-1).
A multiplier is a PLACEHOLDER SHAPE, not a balance decision. Phase 5
replaces this block with an explicit per-level table. It exists so
the city can read a level at all, without inventing thirty rows of
numbers that are going to be thrown away.
footprint tiles, and the model is expected to match it. A building's height
and spread are checked against docs/ART_BIBLE.md by build_asset.py,
which fails the build rather than warning.

buildings.name: Keep
buildings.blurb: The hold itself. Cuts and stores timber from the old fields.

buildings.name: Granary
buildings.blurb: Keeps the grain dry. Feeds everything else you build.

buildings.name: Watchtower
buildings.blurb: Eyes on the treeline. The crew quarry stone between watches.

buildings.name: Croft
buildings.blurb: Raised beds in the old field lines. Grain, and a reason to stay.

buildings.name: Logging Camp
buildings.blurb: The only good wood is at the treeline, and the treeline notices.

buildings.name: Deep Mine
buildings.blurb: A shored shaft into the old workings. Slow, and the only iron there is.
